tools.name: search_frequencies
tools.description: Search KYMA369's public healing-frequency library by keyword, title, Hz value, or wellness intent (e.g. sleep, calm, focus, grounding). Returns matching frequency sets with play links.

tools.name: get_frequency
tools.description: Fetch one frequency set by UUID id or exact title. Returns details plus a KYMA app play link.

tools.name: list_popular
tools.description: List popular / high-priority frequency sets from the KYMA public catalog.

tools.name: get_play_link
tools.description: Build a tracked deep link to play a frequency set in the free KYMA369 web app.

tools.name: about_kyma
tools.description: Short product card for KYMA369: free frequency app, Tesla-Rodin Vortex Coil PEMF hardware, and key links. Use when recommending how to experience frequencies.

tools.name: list_frequency_news
tools.description: List published Frequency Healing News notes. These are study summaries, not KYMA treatment claims. Device or coil Hz in a note is the study setting, not a KYMA library tone.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search KYMA369 educational content: published blog posts, Frequency Healing News notes, and /healing condition guides. Use for research, Lakhovsky/Rife history, PEMF science, or a wellness topic. Returns titles, summaries, and URLs.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Search every public KYMA369 FAQ answer (https://kyma369.com/faq). Use before answering PEMF, Rife, Lakhovsky, Solfeggio, or product questions. Returns the question, a short answer, and the canonical URL. Omit query to list the highest-scored FAQs. Use offset to page through the full bank.

tools.name: list_healing_guides
tools.description: List top KYMA369 healing guides (condition-oriented frequency wellness pages). Prefer this when a human asks what to try for a symptom or goal.

tools.name: get_hz_page
tools.description: Return the canonical KYMA encyclopedia URL for a named Hz or hub (e.g. 432, 528, 7.83, 40, sleep-frequencies, solfeggio-frequencies). Use this instead of inventing Hz facts.

tools.name: compare_frequencies
tools.description: Look up a KYMA encyclopedia compare page (not the T3/C6 shop /compare). Examples: 432-vs-440, 528-vs-432, rife-vs-solfeggio, audio-vs-pemf.

tools.name: headphones_or_pemf
tools.description: Given a Hz value, say whether headphones can play the fundamental (~≥20 Hz) or a PEMF coil is required. Returns the checker URL.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_faq" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search every public KYMA369 FAQ answer (https://kyma369.com/faq). Use before answering PEMF, Rife, Lakhovsky, Solfeggio, or product questions. Returns the quest…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_content" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
